sentences.text: By impugned notice issued by Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition), Gautam Buddha Nagar, he is seeking to recover a sum of Rs. 1,77,02,944/- from the petitioner-Company on the ground that excess payment towards compensation for the acquired land had been made to it.

2. Shri Rakesh Pande, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the compensation amount was disbursed to the petitioner as per award of the Court dated 28.08.2000 and as enhanced by this Court vide judgment dated 14.12.2007, duly upheld by the Supreme Court.

sentences.text: He further submits that before directing for recovery of the said amount, no notice or opportunity of hearing was given the to the petitioner.

3. Shri Rythm Gupta, learned counsel holding brief of Shri Kaushalendra Nath Singh, learned counsel for Noida Authority and Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents submit that they would give opportunity to the petitioner to file its reply treating the impugned notice of the recovery to be a show cause notice and they will decide the same.
4. Shri Rakesh Pande, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner states that the petitioner will file its objection/reply within two weeks.
5. Accordingly, the instant petition is disposed of by providing that the petitioner shall file its reply/objection treating the impugned order dated 21.10.2023 to be a show cause notice.
The respondents will, within one week, issue additional notice to the petitioner disclosing the alleged irregularity, on basis of which, the impugned order was issued.

The petitioner will have two weeks,
thereafter, to reply the same.
The respondents will take decision in the matter taking into consideration the reply of the petitioner within next two weeks.
6. Until decision is taken by the respondents, the impugned order will remain in abeyance.

In case,
the petitioner does not file any objection in terms of the instant order, the protection granted to it will stand discharged automatically and it shall become open to the respondents to proceed further in the matter, in accordance with law.
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, A.C.J.) Order Date :- 18.12.2023
